text:
alex_sales: Quick sync — Pinewell Labs procurement sent PO template and a DPA. They insist on MSA signed before any invoice, separate invoices per legal entity, PO# on every invoice line, and bank remit on PDFs. Can we handle?
mira_legal: MSA-first is fine. Need to confirm signer roles per entity and review the DPA KMS paragraph; will propose a redline.
noah_ops: Technically ok — billing can emit multiple invoices by billing_entity_id and include po_number per line. Need to add po_line_ref so the invoice PDF shows PO line ids. Ops ETA: 1 business day for schema + 1 day QA.
rachel_billing: Also need to mask bank details for security; procurement wants full routing info but we provide masked account + instruction to contact AR for remit details.
sam_finance: Our standard pilot is net30 + 25% deposit. Customer asks net45 and no deposit. Finance can accept net45 only with a deposit (30%) or a payment guarantee.
alex_sales: They want a 12-month price hold on listed SKUs and PO binding on day 0. We committed 6 months verbally — need legal/finance on extended lock.
mira_legal: Draft KMS redline snippet: `Customer-managed KMS allowed; Redwood will not have access to private key material. Integration subject to security review; audit scope to be mutually agreed. Liability limited to gross negligence/willful misconduct.` If they push broader indemnity, escalate to counsel.
noah_ops: DocuSign plan suggestion: Envelope A (MSA consolidated) — execs/legal sign; Envelope B (per-entity order forms + PO ack) — procurement + finance for each entity, referencing MSA ID. This gives separate signed order forms matching invoices.
rachel_billing: Add order form line: `POC credit -$X` so billing won't charge for pilot. Also add `po_bound_on_day0: true` flag in order metadata.
sam_finance: Proposed deposit schedule if net45: 30% due at countersign, remainder invoiced day 1 net45. Finance will approve net45 with that deposit.
docusign-bot: docusign: template created (tmpl_pinewell_msa). Please review signers and per-entity placeholders.
mira_legal: Action items: 1) I'll finalize redline + signer mapping (EOD), 2) @noah_ops implement po_line_ref + envelope templates (1-2 business days), 3) @sam_finance confirm deposit text, 4) @rachel_billing attach SOC2 + subprocessor list and prepare envelopes.
alex_sales: Thanks — I'll loop procurement with proposed signer map and deposit schedule after legal sends the redline. :thumbsup:
